peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 19.3% above its local comparables; 122 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (91.6): 6.3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 358 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $669,000 ($1,896 psf, 344–376 sq ft; 5 resales, Dec 2023–Nov 2025); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,589 psf (range $1,453–1,940); 19.3% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $108,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Aljunied MRT about 520 m, Paya Lebar MRT about 550 m; closer than 297 of 662 similar developments (the same as 19). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Geylang Methodist School (Primary) about 420 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 13 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 180 m), more than 623 of 662 similar developments (the same as 24); nearest hawker centre Blk 117 Aljunied Market And Food Centre about 550 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 1,490 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 117 Aljunied Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 480 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 950 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,070 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,550 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,700 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,710 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,720 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,810 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 303 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 408 new sales and 669 resales (1,077 purchases); new sales were 37.9% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 669 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 243 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 669 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 804 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−16.8%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
